**Nexo 1.3** is a new look: Nexo's own title bar, new themes and colors, profile banners, Nexo in
**Portuguese**, a 12/24-hour clock and new sound effects. Nexo updates itself: look for the **Restart to
update** banner.

> **Hosts:** update your server **before** your friends update Nexo, for profile banners. With Nexo Server:
> stop it, run `nexo-server update`, start it again. Everything else also works with a v1.2 server; there
> the banner editor is just hidden.

## New look

- **Title bar:** on Windows, Nexo draws its own title bar in the theme's colors, with the server name and a
  **Jump to a channel** box (Ctrl K). Minimize, maximize and close are the regular Windows buttons, Snap
  Layouts included.
- **Cleaner design:** neutral greys, a new font, simpler labels and settings, and the in-app logo now matches
  the app icon.
- **Settings → Appearance:**
  - **Theme:** System, Dark, **Midnight** (true black) or Light.
  - **Accent:** Mint, Blue, Violet, Coral, Amber or Rose.
  - **Title bar:** with the search box, or minimal.
  - **App icon:** Classic, Accent, Paper or Mono, for the taskbar, Alt+Tab and the tray.
- **Settings icons:** every section in Settings has one.

## Profile banners

In **Settings → Profile → Banner**, pick an animated style in your color (Flow, Aurora, Waves, Dots or
Swirl) or upload your own picture or animated GIF and crop it. It shows on your profile card.

## Português

**Settings → Language & time → Language:** System, English or **Português (Brasil)**. The whole app, the
tray menu and the server's messages switch right away, without leaving voice.

**Clock:** Automatic (your Windows regional format), 12-hour or 24-hour.

## Voice

- **New sound effects** for mute, deafen, joining and leaving voice, messages, mentions, sign-in requests and
  wake-ups: softer and less beepy.
- **Hide the people row:** while a stream or an emulator game is shown big, **Hide** (the arrow above your
  friends' tiles) gives it that space; **Show N people** brings them back.
- **Fewer music buttons:** start music with the music button in the bottom bar.

## Fixes

- A stream shown big no longer stays stuck big after you stop watching it (the same for a camera that turns
  off).
- A voice channel showed two **Join** buttons, and a failed join showed its error twice.
- Opening Settings with the mouse left a highlight ring on the first tab, and the Settings window changed
  height between tabs.

## Install

Already on Nexo? Nothing to do: it updates itself.

On a **test build**? Go to **Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo. Test
builds only update to newer test builds.

New here? Download the file for your system from the **Assets** below, then see the
[user guide](https://github.com/campiohe/nexo/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md#install). The installers are
**not code-signed**, so your OS will warn you the first time (on Windows: **More info → Run anyway**).
